translations.web: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
translations.bsb: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
translations.kjv: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.
translations.asv: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, saith, He will not require it. All his thoughts are, There is no God.
